item.title: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 Startup Battlefield 200: Celebrating outstanding achievements
item.dc:creator: Michael Schick, Isabelle Johannessen
item.description: Among the Startup Battlefield 200 were many industry-defining companies exhibiting and pitching on the Showcase Stage. Here are the standouts.

item.title: Investors break down how founders can raise a Series A today
item.dc:creator: Dominic-Madori Davis
item.description: Raising a Series A these days isn't so simple — top investors break down what founders need to know now.

item.title: Fusion startup Helion is developing new semiconductors that could double output of its power plants
item.dc:creator: Tim De Chant
item.description: Helion now has another $225 million to help speed development of its first fusion power plant, due to provide Microsoft with electricity in 2028.

item.title: TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026: Everything you need to know
item.dc:creator: TechCrunch Events
item.description: TechCrunch Founder Summit is a full-day gathering in Boston on November 4 where founders across all stages connect with top VCs and experienced entrepreneurs to gain tactical insights on building and scaling their companies.

item.title: Year-old AI lab Flapping Airplanes raises $1B at a $6B valuation
item.dc:creator: Julie Bort
item.description: Just 9 months after raising a $180 million seed round, Flapping Airplanes has landed a $1 billion Series A for its mission to build AI models "without ingesting half the internet."

item.title: Legal AI startup Legora raises $550M Series E at $8.8B valuation
item.dc:creator: Dominic-Madori Davis
item.description: Legal AI startup Legora announced Wednesday that it raised a $550 million Series E round, valuing it at $8.8 billion.

item.title: Blacksmith hits unicorn valuation after Sequoia leads Series C
item.dc:creator: Dominic-Madori Davis
item.description: Blacksmith, a platform that lets companies build and test AI code more effectively, just announced a $66 million Series C round led by Sequoia that values the company at $1 billion.

item.title: Mach9 raises $34M after pivoting to AI CAD software
item.dc:creator: Sean O'Kane
item.description: The startup initially set out to build better, faster, and cheaper surveying hardware in 2021.

item.title: Eric Schmidt reportedly owns about half as much of Anthropic as CEO Dario Amodei
item.dc:creator: Marina Temkin
item.description: Eric Schmidt’s fortune is about to get even bigger.

item.title: Amazon is taking its biggest shot at Nvidia yet with new TorchNeuron dev tool
item.dc:creator: Julie Bort
item.description: Amazon wants to break Nvidia’s hold on PyTorch, the free toolkit used to build most AI apps, so that more developers run their apps on alternative chips like its own.

item.title: Replika’s founder built the AI assistant she pitched at Disrupt 12 years ago
item.dc:creator: Rebecca Bellan
item.description: Eugenia Kuyda's newest startup Wabi is positioned to take advantage of an idea she had more than a decade ago. Wabi offers a personal AI assistant with a twist, free and downloadable to anyone today.

item.title: AI assistant startup Town nabs unicorn valuation 4 months after launch
item.dc:creator: Dominic-Madori Davis
item.description: AI assistant startup Town nabbed a unicorn valuation on Monday, announcing a $108 million Series B round co-led by Forerunner Ventures and Menlo Ventures.

item.title: Khosla Ventures doubles down on Even Healthcare to challenge India’s hospital economics
item.dc:creator: Jagmeet Singh
item.description: Even Healthcare reaches a $300 million valuation in a Khosla Ventures-led round as it plans to expand its hospital network in India.

item.title: Disney agrees to hire the majority of Character AI’s workforce
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ha
item.description: The filing also says that the “vast majority” of Character.AI employees who were offered jobs at Disney accepted them. However, this is a stalking horse bid, so another company could come forward with a higher offer.

item.title: Physical AI is more than robots, says the Nvidia veteran now investing in it
item.dc:creator: Theresa Loconsolo, Dominic-Madori Davis
item.description: Amulya Vishwanath, who spent seven years leading product marketing for NVIDIA’s robotics platforms, says robotics is currently in its “Lego era,” with the basic building blocks like actuators, robotic hands, software, and safety standards still being rebuilt.  This view runs counter to those who believe that robotics, powered by a general foundation model, is about to have […]

item.title: Elorian’s first AI model wants to reason with images, not just about them
item.dc:creator: Aditya Mehta
item.description: According to Elorian's evaluations, Glimpse outperforms even GPT-6 Astra on scientific chart reasoning and short-form video captioning, with competitive results on other visual reasoning tasks.

item.title: Tressfecta wants to make hair braiding a less arduous task for hairstylists
item.dc:creator: Dominic-Madori Davis
item.description: Tressfecta builds products for textured hair. Its first project is a tool called Plait Pilot that helps braiders with the initial process of separating hair from packs before braiding begins.

item.title: Veritas expands its anti-counterfeit chip to jewelry, trophies, and fragrance bottles
item.dc:creator: Ivan Mehta
item.description: Counterfeiters are getting better at replicating brands' marks and passing off dupes, known as "superfakes," as genuine items. A startup called Veritas wants to tackle the problem with its own chip that verifies goods.

item.title: When it came to Cal AI’s viral success, a small army of influencers paid off
item.dc:creator: Lucas Ropek
item.description: The company generated over $30 million in revenue in two years and was acquired by MyFitnessPal for an undisclosed amount of money in March.
